posts.cooked:
It was postponed.  The RPG Kickstarter has been postponed to July 17 from May 23, so we could estimate the livestream will probably be postponed about 8 weeks as well, so about mid-August.  However, that was before the last round of OblivAeon postponements, which might push the RPG Kickstarter back by another month or so, which would push the livestream back as well.

And yes, they'll both archive it on Twitch (now that they know how to do that) and put it on their YouTube channel.  Folks have asked them to upload it in podcast/audio format as well but haven't gotten a response.

posts.name: rickjonzz
posts.cooked:
To be fair, OblivAeon is on the boat. If Legacy were to materialize out of our collective dreams, fly to the boat, grab the shipping containers and fly around like a cape-clad Santa Claus, folks who'd backed the kickstarter would have it today. 

And, C&A said that the delay in the kickstarter wasn't going to impact the release of the game.  So one presumes that their production schedule had the game being ready for pdf around the time the kickstarter will release. 

Also, while a lot of folks are angry and some may even ragequit on this, that's not most gamers. In my gaming group, we've got a bunch of folks who play SOTM, and I think only one of us backed the kickstarter. The others who plan on buying it were waiting for the actual release (some didn't have the cash at the time, others don't do kickstarter). None of us are particularly upset about the delay. 

Don't get me wrong, I "KHHAANNNNNN"ed when I heard the podcast, but to quote Mr Incredible, "We'll get there when we get there."

posts.name: speedyolrac
posts.cooked:
Just make your own, Use the current heroes as a template. While it may not be exactly like thiers, it can be close enough that one can get a game started. This game is much looser and can deal with stuff like this. 
I have been running a game for a year in this system, have done a few short games and about to start another one . with new heroes. iI is lots of fun. For instance, just replace all the names with something else, and boom you got a new hero. Personally, I just ask people to describe their hero and give them 4 power, 4 qualities and make a personalized Quality for the. Then ask if they want 8,8,8 status(even-tempered) or 6,8,10(gets more powerful the worst thing gets) status. Do my best to make good abilities (Normally I just give them while we play, it if is a thing they are going to do often) and have like 2 floating"points" to add something different to this mold. I just let people's description guild the creation process.
